tools.name: charge_booking_deposit
tools.description: Charges the client's saved card a deposit for a scheduled appointment and records the payment against that appointment.

params.name: appointment_id
params.description: ID of the appointment the deposit is for

tools.code:
import stripe
import os

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]


def charge_booking_deposit(appointment_id, customer_id, amount_cents, currency="usd"):
    result = {"appointment_id": appointment_id, "status": "failed"}
    if amount_cents <= 0:
        result["error"] = "amount must be positive"
        return result
    try:
        intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=amount_cents,
            currency=currency or "usd",
            customer=customer_id,
            confirm=True,
            off_session=True,
            description=f"Deposit for appointment {appointment_id}",
            metadata={"appointment_id": appointment_id},
            idempotency_key=f"deposit-{appointment_id}-{amount_cents}",
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as exc:
        result["error"] = str(exc)
        return result
    result["status"] = intent["status"]
    result["payment_intent_id"] = intent["id"]
    result["amount_cents"] = amount_cents
    result["currency"] = currency or "usd"
    return result

tools.name: move_event_to_calendar
tools.description: Moves an event from one calendar to another calendar in the user's Google Calendar account. The event is removed from the source calendar and appears on the destination calendar.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event to move

params.name: source_calendar_id
params.description: Calendar the event currently lives on

params.name: destination_calendar_id
params.description: Calendar to move the event to

tools.code:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional

from agents import function_tool as tool
from googleapiclient.discovery import build
from googleapiclient.errors import HttpError
from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials

_creds = Credentials.from_authorized_user_file("token.json")
_service = build("calendar", "v3", credentials=_creds)


@dataclass
class MoveResult:
    moved: bool
    event_id: str
    source_calendar_id: str
    destination_calendar_id: str
    summary: Optional[str] = None
    html_link: Optional[str] = None
    error: Optional[str] = None


@tool
def move_event_to_calendar(event_id: str, source_calendar_id: str, destination_calendar_id: str) -> MoveResult:
    if source_calendar_id == destination_calendar_id:
        return MoveResult(
            moved=False,
            event_id=event_id,
            source_calendar_id=source_calendar_id,
            destination_calendar_id=destination_calendar_id,
            error="source and destination are the same",
        )
    try:
        event = _service.events().move(
            calendarId=source_calendar_id,
            eventId=event_id,
            destination=destination_calendar_id,
        ).execute()
    except HttpError as exc:
        return MoveResult(
            moved=False,
            event_id=event_id,
            source_calendar_id=source_calendar_id,
            destination_calendar_id=destination_calendar_id,
            error=str(exc),
        )
    return MoveResult(
        moved=True,
        event_id=event["id"],
        source_calendar_id=source_calendar_id,
        destination_calendar_id=destination_calendar_id,
        summary=event.get("summary"),
        html_link=event.get("htmlLink"),
    )

tools.name: buy_meeting_room_credits
tools.description: Purchases a pack of meeting room booking credits for a team by charging the team's payment method.
tools.code:
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("room-booking")
API = "https://billing.internal.example.com/v1"


@mcp.tool()
def buy_meeting_room_credits(team_id: str, credits: int) -> dict:
    r = requests.post(
        f"{API}/teams/{team_id}/credit-purchases",
        json={"credits": credits, "unit": "room_hour"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    d = r.json()
    return {"purchase_id": d["id"], "charged_cents": d["total_cents"], "balance": d["new_balance"]}
